description: Small curated evaluation using real public patent records. Expected identifiers are evaluation labels, never supplied to the matching engine as hints.

blindPdf.title: ATTACHMENT POSITION CONFIRMATION MEMBER, OSTEOTOMY ASSISTANCE KIT, AND POSITION DETECTION PROGRAM

positives.label: Osteotomy attachment confirmation — independently phrased technical description
positives.text: An osteotomy guide has cutting slits and guide holes that keep bone fixation rods in a planned relation after correction. A removable feature-point indication rod touches an anatomical landmark and is held by a rod support unit on a sliding elongate member. A second support reads graduated scales to confirm where the surgical guide sits on the bone.

positives.label: Recapturable vascular support — independently phrased technical description
positives.text: A self-expanding tubular stent has separate elongated legs projecting from its proximal side. Retaining flanges near the proximal tips engage a second implanted graft. The delivery catheter permits the clinician to recapture and reposition this support before its final deployment.

positives.label: Femoral fixation — French description matching the original French claims
positives.text: Une prothèse de hanche relie une tête articulaire à une tige ancrée dans le canal du fémur par du ciment. Sa zone de fixation présente une silhouette en étrave, avec un bord médian courbe adapté à l’os. Un rebord sépare la partie d’assemblage des zones qui s’évasent vers l’arrière et vers l’avant.

negativeText: A bamboo garden parasol has a linen canopy, folding ribs and a hand-pulled rope over a pulley. A wooden crank opens the fabric cover and a stone base holds the mast upright.

historicalBlindPdf.title: An improved stent which is easly recaptured and repositioned within the body
